package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const planningReadinessStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func TestPlanningReadinessDraftPreservesPartialFactsAndExactIntent(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	direction, experience, goal, language := "undecided", "beginner", "learn_programming", "ru"
	empty := []string{}
	draft := StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID,
		Status: StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, Version: 4, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now,
		StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{
			DirectionCode: &direction, SelfAssessedExperience: &experience, GoalCode: &goal,
			KnownStacks: &empty, PreferredLanguage: &language,
		},
	}
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(StudentPlanningReadinessSource{StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID, Draft: &draft})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.StateRef.Kind != "accepted_draft" || result.StateRef.Version != 4 || result.LearningIntent == nil || result.LearningIntent.Code != "learn_programming" || result.LearningIntent.Source != "onboarding_goal_code.v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected draft readiness: %+v", result)
	}
	if result.Profile.DirectionCode == nil || *result.Profile.DirectionCode != "undecided" || result.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience == nil || *result.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience != "beginner" || result.Profile.KnownStacks.State != "answered" || result.Profile.KnownStacks.Values == nil || len(*result.Profile.KnownStacks.Values) != 0 || result.Profile.DesiredStacks.State != "unanswered" || result.Profile.DesiredStacks.Values != nil || result.Profile.WeeklyMinutes != nil || result.Profile.PreferredPace != nil {
		t.Fatalf("partial values were changed: %+v", result.Profile)
	}
	if result.Profile.PreferredLanguage == nil || result.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance != "untrusted_persisted" || result.Profile.ContentLanguage != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unprovenanced language was trusted: %+v", result.Profile)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(encoded), `"known_stacks":{"state":"answered","values":[]}`) || strings.Contains(string(encoded), `"desired_stacks":{"state":"unanswered","values"`) {
		t.Fatalf("stack wire semantics=%s err=%v", encoded, err)
	}
}

func TestPlanningReadinessCarriesEarlierTrustedLanguageAcrossLaterDraftTurns(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	goal, language := "career_change", "en"
	draft := StudentOnboardingDraft{Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID, Status: StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, Version: 4, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now, StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{GoalCode: &goal, PreferredLanguage: &language}}
	provenanceLanguage := language
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(StudentPlanningReadinessSource{StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID, Draft: &draft, Provenance: []StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance{{SlotCode: StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage, CodeValue: &provenanceLanguage, AcceptedDraftVersion: 2, Origin: StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.LearningIntent != nil {
		t.Fatalf("non-exact goal created intent: %+v", result.LearningIntent)
	}
	if result.Profile.ContentLanguage == nil || result.Profile.ContentLanguage.Code != "en" || result.Profile.ContentLanguage.Provenance != "explicit_text" || result.Profile.ContentLanguage.Source != "preferred_language" {
		t.Fatalf("trusted language missing content evidence: %+v", result.Profile)
	}
}

func TestPlanningReadinessLegacyProfileDoesNotInventEmptyStackAnswerAndCarriesSelectedActivePath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	profile := StudentOnboarding{StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner", KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "learn_programming", PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 240, PreferredPace: "steady", ProfileVersion: StudentOnboardingProfileVersion, Version: 3, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	path := StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath{LearningPathID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Version: 5, CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "learn_programming", Status: "ACTIVE"}
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(StudentPlanningReadinessSource{StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID, Profile: &profile, ActivePath: &path})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.StateRef.Kind != "finalized_profile" || result.Profile.KnownStacks.State != "unresolved" || result.Profile.KnownStacks.Values != nil || result.Profile.PreferredLanguage == nil || result.Profile.PreferredLanguage.Provenance != "untrusted_persisted" || result.Profile.ContentLanguage != nil || result.ActivePath == nil || result.ActivePath.LearningPathID != path.LearningPathID || result.ActivePath.Status != "ACTIVE" {
		t.Fatalf("legacy facts not represented honestly: %+v", result)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil || string(encoded) == "" || string(encoded) == "null" {
		t.Fatalf("marshal=%q err=%v", encoded, err)
	}
}

func TestPlanningReadinessFinalizedProfileTrustsEarlierExplicitLanguageFromSameDraftLineage(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	profileVersion := int64(1)
	draft := StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID,
		Status: StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted, Version: 5, CompletedProfileVersion: &profileVersion,
		CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now, CompletedAt: &now,
	}
	profile := StudentOnboarding{
		StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner",
		KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "learn_programming", PreferredLanguage: "ru",
		WeeklyMinutes: 240, PreferredPace: "steady", ProfileVersion: StudentOnboardingProfileVersion, Version: profileVersion,
		CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	language := "ru"
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(StudentPlanningReadinessSource{
		StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID, Draft: &draft, Profile: &profile,
		Provenance: []StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance{{
			SlotCode: StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage, CodeValue: &language,
			AcceptedDraftVersion: 2, Origin: StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText,
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Profile.ContentLanguage == nil || result.Profile.ContentLanguage.Code != "ru" ||
		result.Profile.ContentLanguage.Provenance != "explicit_text" {
		t.Fatalf("earlier explicit language was not retained through finalization: %+v", result.Profile)
	}
}

func TestPlanningReadinessMissingStateIsStable(t *testing.T) {
	result, err := BuildStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(StudentPlanningReadinessSource{StudentID: planningReadinessStudentID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.StateRef.Kind != "none" || result.StateRef.Version != 0 || result.LearningIntent != nil || result.Profile.KnownStacks.State != "unanswered" || result.Profile.DesiredStacks.State != "unanswered" {
		t.Fatalf("missing state=%+v", result)
	}
}
